The query returns all **995 artifacts**, retaining rows where the name or readings are missing. Using the latest environmental reading for each artifact’s most recently assessed showcase, **ART54254 (Poor Vase)** is the only one flagged “Yes”: 18°C, 54% humidity, and 2 high sensitivities.

```sql
WITH assessment_cases AS (
  SELECT
    art_exam,
    case_exam,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY art_exam
      ORDER BY assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, cond_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ConditionAssessments
  WHERE art_exam IS NOT NULL
),
latest_readings AS (
  SELECT
    case_link,
    TEMPc,
    RH,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY case_link
      ORDER BY readTS DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
  WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL
),
sensitivity_values AS (
  SELECT
    ART_link,
    json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') AS light,
    json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') AS temperature,
    json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') AS humidity,
    json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') AS vibration,
    json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') AS pollutants
  FROM SensitivityData
),
sensitivity AS (
  SELECT
    ART_link,
    (
      CASE WHEN light = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN temperature = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN humidity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN vibration = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN pollutants = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS high_sensitivity_count,
    (
      COALESCE(CASE light WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE temperature WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE humidity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE vibration WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE pollutants WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
    ) / NULLIF(
      (light IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
      (temperature IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
      (humidity IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
      (vibration IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
      (pollutants IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER,
      0
    ) AS erf
  FROM sensitivity_values
),
values_for_mdr AS (
  SELECT
    a.ARTregID,
    a.art_title,
    lr.TEMPc,
    lr.RH,
    COALESCE(s.high_sensitivity_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
    (a."ageYears" * s.erf * POWER(lr.RH - 50, 2) * lr.TEMPc) / 100000.0 AS mdr
  FROM ArtifactsCore AS a
  LEFT JOIN assessment_cases AS ac
    ON ac.art_exam = a.ARTregID
   AND ac.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN latest_readings AS lr
    ON lr.case_link = ac.case_exam
   AND lr.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN sensitivity AS s
    ON s.ART_link = a.ARTregID
)
SELECT
  ARTregID AS artifact_id,
  art_title AS artifact_name,
  TEMPc AS current_temp_c,
  RH AS current_humidity_pct,
  high_sensitivity_count,
  CASE
    WHEN mdr > 5 AND high_sensitivity_count >= 2 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS danger_zone
FROM values_for_mdr
ORDER BY ARTregID;
```

answer:
An anomaly day is counted once if at least one recorded temperature that day was more than 0 and no more than 4°C from that year’s average. There are no environmental readings from 2023, so its average is unavailable.

| Year | Average temperature (°C) | Anomaly days |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 2023 | N/A | 0 |
| 2024 | 19.9945 | 287 |
| 2025 | 20.0859 | 46 |

```sql
WITH years(year) AS (
  VALUES (2023), (2024), (2025)
),
yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
         AVG("TEMPc") AS average_temperature
  FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") IN (2023, 2024, 2025)
    AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
anomaly_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
         CAST(e."readTS" AS DATE) AS reading_day
  FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
  JOIN yearly_avg AS a
    ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::INTEGER = a.year
  WHERE e."TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
    AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - a.average_temperature) > 0
    AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - a.average_temperature) <= 4
)
SELECT y.year,
       a.average_temperature,
       COUNT(d.reading_day) AS anomaly_days
FROM years AS y
LEFT JOIN yearly_avg AS a ON a.year = y.year
LEFT JOIN anomaly_days AS d ON d.year = y.year
GROUP BY y.year, a.average_temperature
ORDER BY y.year;
```

I found two artifacts with cultural scores above 80 whose showcase temperatures differ by more than 1°C from the average temperature of the other showcases in the same hall. The hall average below is the average of those other showcases’ average temperatures.

| Artifact ID | Title | Material | Showcase temperature (°C) | Other-showcases average (°C) | Exact deviation (°C) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ART22173 | Actually Painting | Wood | 22.0 | 19.670833333333334 | 2.3291666666666657 |
| ART48028 | Pm Sculpture | Jade | 19.0 | 20.162790697674417 | 1.1627906976744171 |

```sql
WITH showcase_temps AS (
    SELECT
        s.caseID,
        s.hall_ref,
        AVG(e."TEMPc"::DOUBLE) AS showcase_temp
    FROM Showcases AS s
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
        ON e.case_link = s.caseID
    WHERE e."TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.caseID, s.hall_ref
),
peer_baselines AS (
    SELECT
        a.caseID,
        a.showcase_temp,
        AVG(b.showcase_temp)
            FILTER (WHERE b.caseID <> a.caseID) AS other_showcases_avg_temp
    FROM showcase_temps AS a
    JOIN showcase_temps AS b
        ON b.hall_ref = a.hall_ref
    GROUP BY a.caseID, a.showcase_temp
),
artifact_cases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT art_exam, case_exam
    FROM ConditionAssessments
    WHERE art_exam IS NOT NULL
      AND case_exam IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    art.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
    art.art_title AS title,
    art.MatKind AS material,
    p.showcase_temp,
    p.other_showcases_avg_temp AS hall_average_temp,
    ABS(p.showcase_temp - p.other_showcases_avg_temp) AS exact_deviation
FROM ArtifactRatings AS ar
JOIN ArtifactsCore AS art
    ON art.ARTregID = ar.ART_link
JOIN artifact_cases AS ac
    ON ac.art_exam = art.ARTregID
JOIN peer_baselines AS p
    ON p.caseID = ac.case_exam
WHERE TRY_CAST(ar.rating_profile ->> '$.cultural_score' AS DOUBLE) > 80
  AND p.other_showcases_avg_temp IS NOT NULL
  AND ABS(p.showcase_temp - p.other_showcases_avg_temp) > 1
ORDER BY exact_deviation DESC, artifact_id;
```

An anomaly day is counted once if at least one non-NULL temperature reading that day was more than 0 and no more than 4°C from that year’s average.

```sql
WITH years AS (
    SELECT 2023 AS year
    UNION ALL SELECT 2024
    UNION ALL SELECT 2025

yearly AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
        AVG("TEMPc") AS avg_temp
    FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") IN (2023, 2024, 2025)
      AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
anomaly_days AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(e."readTS" AS DATE)) AS anomaly_days
    FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
    JOIN yearly AS y
      ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::INTEGER = y.year
    WHERE e."TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
      AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) > 0
      AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) <= 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ys.year,
    y.avg_temp,
    COALESCE(a.anomaly_days, 0) AS anomaly_days
FROM years AS ys
LEFT JOIN yearly AS y ON y.year = ys.year
LEFT JOIN anomaly_days AS a ON a.year = ys.year
ORDER BY ys.year;
```

I treated **danger zone** as the defined accelerated-deterioration condition: MDR greater than 5 and at least two of the five environmental sensitivities rated High. “Current” means the latest reading linked through an artifact’s condition-assessment showcase. The metric definition notes that artifacts can link to multiple readings but does not specify which one to use; if there is no reading or required data is missing, the query returns **No** rather than dropping the artifact.

```sql
WITH sensitivity AS (
    SELECT
        sd.ART_link,
        (
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0
        ) AS erf,
        (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sensitivity_count
    FROM main.SensitivityData sd
),
ranked_readings AS (
    SELECT
        ca.art_exam,
        erc."TEMPc" AS current_temp_c,
        erc."RH" AS current_humidity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.art_exam
            ORDER BY erc.readTS DESC NULLS LAST, erc.monitor_code DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM main.ConditionAssessments ca
    JOIN main.EnvironmentalReadingsCore erc
        ON erc.case_link = ca.case_exam
    WHERE ca.art_exam IS NOT NULL
),
current_reading AS (
    SELECT art_exam, current_temp_c, current_humidity
    FROM ranked_readings
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ac.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
    ac.art_title AS artifact_name,
    cr.current_temp_c,
    cr.current_humidity,
    COALESCE(s.high_sensitivity_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
    CASE
        WHEN ac.ageYears IS NOT NULL
         AND s.erf IS NOT NULL
         AND cr.current_temp_c IS NOT NULL
         AND cr.current_humidity IS NOT NULL
         AND (ac.ageYears * s.erf * POWER(cr.current_humidity - 50, 2) * cr.current_temp_c) / 100000.0 > 5
         AND COALESCE(s.high_sensitivity_count, 0) >= 2
        THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS danger_zone
FROM main.ArtifactsCore ac
LEFT JOIN sensitivity s
    ON s.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
LEFT JOIN current_reading cr
    ON cr.art_exam = ac.ARTregID
ORDER BY ac.ARTregID;
```

Using each showcase’s average temperature, then averaging those showcase averages for the *other* showcases in the same hall, I found two matches:

```sql
WITH artifact_case AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT art_exam, case_exam
  FROM ConditionAssessments
  WHERE art_exam IS NOT NULL
    AND case_exam IS NOT NULL
),
showcase_temps AS (
  SELECT
    case_link AS case_id,
    AVG(TEMPc) AS showcase_avg_temp
  FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
  WHERE case_link IS NOT NULL
    AND TEMPc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY case_link
),
case_hall AS (
  SELECT
    s.caseID AS case_id,
    s.hall_ref,
    st.showcase_avg_temp
  FROM Showcases s
  JOIN showcase_temps st
    ON st.case_id = s.caseID
),
hall_other_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    a.case_id,
    a.hall_ref,
    AVG(b.showcase_avg_temp) AS other_showcases_avg_temp
  FROM case_hall a
  JOIN case_hall b
    ON b.hall_ref = a.hall_ref
   AND b.case_id <> a.case_id
  GROUP BY a.case_id, a.hall_ref
)
SELECT
  ac.art_exam AS artifact_id,
  art.art_title,
  art.MatKind AS material,
  ch.showcase_avg_temp AS showcase_temperature,
  ho.other_showcases_avg_temp AS hall_average_temp,
  ABS(ch.showcase_avg_temp - ho.other_showcases_avg_temp) AS deviation
FROM artifact_case ac
JOIN ArtifactsCore art
  ON art.ARTregID = ac.art_exam
JOIN case_hall ch
  ON ch.case_id = ac.case_exam
JOIN hall_other_avgs ho
  ON ho.case_id = ch.case_id
JOIN ArtifactRatings ar
  ON ar.ART_link = art.ARTregID
WHERE TRY_CAST(
        json_extract_string(ar.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score')
```

```sql
WITH years(year) AS (
  VALUES (2023), (2024), (2025)
),
valid_readings AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
    CAST("readTS" AS DATE) AS reading_day,
    CAST("TEMPc" AS DOUBLE) AS temperature
  FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") IN (2023, 2024, 2025)
    AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
    AND isfinite(CAST("TEMPc" AS DOUBLE))
),
annual_average AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature
  FROM valid_readings
  GROUP BY year
),
daily_average AS (
  SELECT year, reading_day, AVG(temperature) AS daily_temperature
  FROM valid_readings
  GROUP BY year, reading_day
),
anomaly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE ABS(d.daily_temperature - a.avg_temperature) > 0
        AND ABS(d.daily_temperature - a.avg_temperature) <= 4
    ) AS anomaly_days
  FROM daily_average d
  JOIN annual_average a USING (year)
  GROUP BY d.year
)
SELECT
  y.year,
  a.avg_temperature,
  COALESCE(c.anomaly_days, 0) AS anomaly_days
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN annual_average a USING (year)
LEFT JOIN anomaly_counts c USING (year)
ORDER BY y.year;
```

```sql
WITH case_signals AS (
    SELECT
        e.case_link,
        AVG(
            CASE s."pestActivity"
                WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
            + CASE s."saltRisk"
                WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
            + CASE s."condRisk"
                WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
            + CASE s."thermalImg"
                WHEN 'Critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'Attention Required' THEN 2 WHEN 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
            + CASE s."structStable"
                WHEN 'Major Issues' THEN 3 WHEN 'Minor Issues' THEN 2 WHEN 'Stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
            + CASE s."crackNote"
                WHEN 'Significant Changes' THEN 3 WHEN 'Minor Changes' THEN 2 WHEN 'No Changes' THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS surface_threat
    FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore e
    JOIN SurfaceAndPhysicalReadings s
        ON s.env_link = e.monitor_code
    GROUP BY e.case_link
),
showcase_signals AS (
    SELECT
        caseID,
        CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.maint_status')
            WHEN 'Overdue' THEN 3 WHEN 'Due' THEN 2 WHEN 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.filter_status')
            WHEN 'Replace Now' THEN 3 WHEN 'Replace Soon' THEN 2 WHEN 'Clean' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.silica_status')
            WHEN 'Replace Now' THEN 3 WHEN 'Replace Soon' THEN 2 WHEN 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.physical_state.seal_state')
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.fire_system_state')
            WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 3 WHEN 'Standby' THEN 2 WHEN 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.inert_gas_state')
            WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 3 WHEN 'Standby' THEN 2 WHEN 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.primary_power_state')
            WHEN 'Testing' THEN 3 WHEN 'Standby' THEN 2 WHEN 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
        + CASE json_extract_string(case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.backup_power_state')
            WHEN 'Maintenance' THEN 3 WHEN 'Testing' THEN 2 WHEN 'Ready' THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS showcase_threat
    FROM Showcases
),
artifact_case AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT art_exam, case_exam
    FROM ConditionAssessments
    WHERE art_exam IS NOT NULL
      AND case_exam IS NOT NULL
),
artifact_scores AS (
    SELECT
        ac.art_exam AS registration_id,
        AVG(COALESCE(cs.surface_threat, 0) + COALESCE(ss.showcase_threat, 0)) AS threat_score
    FROM artifact_case ac
    LEFT JOIN case_signals cs
        ON cs.case_link = ac.case_exam
    LEFT JOIN showcase_signals ss
        ON ss.caseID = ac.case_exam
    GROUP BY ac.art_exam
)
SELECT
    r.art_concern AS registration_id,
    a.threat_score
FROM RiskAssessments r
JOIN artifact_scores a
    ON a.registration_id = r.art_concern
WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
ORDER BY a.threat_score DESC, r.art_concern
LIMIT 10;
```

The schema doesn’t specify a safe-display limit or a rotation-score formula, so I’ve used an explicit convention: High/Medium/Low sensitivity maps to 3/6/12 months; without a sensitivity profile, Paper and Textile use 3 months, Wood 6, and other materials 12. The score is months on display ÷ safe months × 100, and scores at or above 100 are flagged for Immediate Rotation. Where an artifact has multiple resting records, the query uses its greatest recorded display duration as a conservative estimate.

```sql
WITH resting_items AS (
    SELECT
        a.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
        a.art_title,
        a.MatKind AS material,
        MAX(u."displayMonths") AS months_on_display,
        sd.env_handling_sensitivity
    FROM UsageRecords u
    LEFT JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore e
        ON e.monitor_code = u.env_link
    LEFT JOIN Monitor_Showcase_Map mm
        ON mm.mon_ID = u.env_link
    LEFT JOIN ConditionAssessments ca
        ON ca.case_exam = COALESCE(e.case_link, mm.case_ID)
    JOIN ArtifactsCore a
        ON a.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    LEFT JOIN SensitivityData sd
        ON sd.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    WHERE u.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
    GROUP BY
        a.ARTregID,
        a.art_title,
        a.MatKind,
        sd.env_handling_sensitivity
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.context.display') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.context.storage') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.biological.pest') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.handling_transport.handling') = 'High'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.handling_transport.transport') = 'High'
                THEN 'High'
            WHEN json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.context.display') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.context.storage') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.biological.pest') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.handling_transport.handling') = 'Medium'
              OR json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.handling_transport.transport') = 'Medium'
                THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN env_handling_sensitivity IS NOT NULL THEN 'Low'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS sensitivity_band
    FROM resting_items
),
limits AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN sensitivity_band = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN sensitivity_band = 'Medium' THEN 6
            WHEN sensitivity_band = 'Low' THEN 12
            WHEN material IN ('Paper', 'Textile') THEN 3
            WHEN material = 'Wood' THEN 6
            ELSE 12
        END AS max_safe_display_months
    FROM classified
)
SELECT
    artifact_id AS id,
    art_title AS name,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    max_safe_display_months,
    ROUND(100.0 * months_on_display / max_safe_display_months, 2)
        AS final_rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN months_on_display >= max_safe_display_months THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_flag
FROM limits
ORDER BY final_rotation_priority_score DESC NULLS LAST, id;
```

```sql
WITH showcase_temps AS (
    SELECT s.caseID, s.hall_ref, AVG(e."TEMPc") AS showcase_avg_temp
    FROM Showcases AS s
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e ON e.case_link = s.caseID
    GROUP BY s.caseID, s.hall_ref
),
other_showcase_avgs AS (
    SELECT current.caseID,
           AVG(other.showcase_avg_temp) AS hall_avg_temp_other_showcases
    FROM showcase_temps AS current
    JOIN showcase_temps AS other
      ON other.hall_ref = current.hall_ref
     AND other.caseID <> current.caseID
    GROUP BY current.caseID
),
artifact_cases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT art_exam, case_exam
    FROM ConditionAssessments
)
SELECT ac.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
       ac.art_title AS title,
       ac.MatKind AS material,
       st.showcase_avg_temp AS showcase_avg_temperature,
       osa.hall_avg_temp_other_showcases,
       ABS(st.showcase_avg_temp - osa.hall_avg_temp_other_showcases) AS exact_deviation
FROM artifact_cases AS x
JOIN ArtifactsCore AS ac ON ac.ARTregID = x.art_exam
JOIN ArtifactRatings AS ar ON ar.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
JOIN showcase_temps AS st ON st.caseID = x.case_exam
JOIN other_showcase_avgs AS osa ON osa.caseID = st.caseID
WHERE (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::DOUBLE > 80
  AND ABS(st.showcase_avg_temp - osa.hall_avg_temp_other_showcases) > 1
ORDER BY ac.ARTregID;
```

The anomaly count compares each **day’s average temperature** with that year’s average, counting days with an absolute deviation greater than 0 and no more than 4°C. There are no valid temperature readings for 2023, so its average is NULL.

| Year | Average temperature (°C) | Anomaly days |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 2023 | NULL | 0 |
| 2024 | 19.9945 | 287 |
| 2025 | 20.0859 | 46 |

```sql
WITH years AS (
    SELECT 2023 AS year
    UNION ALL SELECT 2024
    UNION ALL SELECT 2025
),
valid_readings AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::INTEGER AS year,
        CAST("readTS" AS DATE) AS reading_day,
        "TEMPc" AS temperature
    FROM main.EnvironmentalReadingsCore
    WHERE "readTS" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND "readTS" < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite("TEMPc")
),
yearly_averages AS (
    SELECT year, AVG(temperature) AS average_temperature
    FROM valid_readings
    GROUP BY year
),
daily_averages AS (
    SELECT year, reading_day, AVG(temperature) AS daily_average_temperature
    FROM valid_readings
    GROUP BY year, reading_day
)
SELECT
    yrs.year,
    ya.average_temperature,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN ABS(d.daily_average_temperature - ya.average_temperature) > 0
         AND ABS(d.daily_average_temperature - ya.average_temperature) <= 4
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS anomaly_days
FROM years yrs
LEFT JOIN yearly_averages ya ON ya.year = yrs.year
LEFT JOIN daily_averages d ON d.year = yrs.year
GROUP BY yrs.year, ya.average_temperature
ORDER BY yrs.year;
```

answer:
The resting records map to **332 artifact/usage rows across 322 distinct artifacts**. Only one row has all the rating and sensitivity inputs needed to calculate both the safe display duration and rotation score: **ART54254** has a maximum safe display time of **0 months**, an ERPS of **−2,156.27**, and is flagged **Immediate Rotation**. The other rows have missing calculation inputs, so their scores are `NULL`; the query labels them `Monitor` as requested.

```sql
WITH inputs AS (
    SELECT
        a.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
        a.art_title AS name,
        a.MatKind AS material,
        ur.displayMonths AS months_on_display,
        a.conserve_status,
        ar.HIST_sign AS historical_significance,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ar.rating_profile, '$.research_score') AS DOUBLE) AS research_score,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ar.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score') AS DOUBLE) AS cultural_score,
        json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') AS light_sensitivity,
        json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') AS temperature_sensitivity,
        json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') AS humidity_sensitivity,
        lr.lux,
        lr.visLxh
    FROM UsageRecords AS ur
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
        ON e.monitor_code = ur.env_link
    JOIN ConditionAssessments AS ca
        ON ca.case_exam = e.case_link
    JOIN ArtifactsCore AS a
        ON a.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    LEFT JOIN ArtifactRatings AS ar
        ON ar.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN SensitivityData AS sd
        ON sd.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings AS lr
        ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
    WHERE ur.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
),
weighted AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE light_sensitivity
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0
        END AS light_weight,
        CASE temperature_sensitivity
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0
        END AS temperature_weight,
        CASE humidity_sensitivity
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0
        END AS humidity_weight,
        CASE conserve_status
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1.0
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 3.0
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5.0
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7.0
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10.0
        END AS status_value
    FROM inputs
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        36.0
            * (10.0 - light_weight)
            * (10.0 - temperature_weight)
            * (10.0 - humidity_weight)
            / 1000.0 AS max_safe_display_months,
        (historical_significance + research_score + cultural_score)
            * (10.0 - status_value)
            / 30.0 AS cpi,
        (lux * light_weight * visLxh) / 1000.0 AS ler
    FROM weighted
),
final_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
            * (ler + 1.0)
            * (cpi + 1.0)
            / 100.0 AS erps
    FROM scores
)
SELECT
    artifact_id,
    name,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    ROUND(max_safe_display_months, 2) AS max_safe_display_months,
    ROUND(erps, 2) AS final_rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN erps < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_action
FROM final_scores
ORDER BY artifact_id, months_on_display;
```

            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5.0
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7.0
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10.0
        END AS status_value
    FROM inputs
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        36.0
            * (10.0 - light_weight)
            * (10.0 - temperature_weight)
            * (10.0 - humidity_weight)
            / 1000.0 AS max_safe_display_months,
        (historical_significance + research_score + cultural_score)
            * (10.0 - status_value)
            / 30.0 AS cpi,
        (lux * light_weight * visLxh) / 1000.0 AS ler
    FROM weighted
),
final_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
            * (ler + 1.0)
            * (cpi + 1.0)
            / 100.0 AS erps
    FROM scores
)
SELECT
    artifact_id,
    name,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    ROUND(max_safe_display_months, 2) AS max_safe_display_months,
    ROUND(erps, 2) AS final_rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN erps < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_action
FROM final_scores
ORDER BY artifact_id, months_on_display;

The priority score uses the governed Conservation Priority Index (CPI). The report includes the 10 artifacts with rating records; a score is NULL where the required conservation status is missing. If an artifact has multiple linked budget allocations, the query lists the distinct allocations; funding is “Sufficient” only when all are “Adequate.” “Review Required” and “Insufficient” are classified as “Insufficient.”

```sql
WITH artifact_budgets AS (
    SELECT
        ca.art_exam AS ARTregID,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.budget_alloc, ', ' ORDER BY m.budget_alloc) AS specific_budget,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE m.budget_alloc IS NULL OR m.budget_alloc <> 'Adequate'
        ) AS non_adequate_allocations,
        COUNT(m.maint_id) AS maintenance_record_count
    FROM main.ConditionAssessments ca
    JOIN main.LightAndRadiationReadings lr
        ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
    JOIN main.ConservationAndMaintenance m
        ON m.monitor_link = lr.env_link
    GROUP BY ca.art_exam
)
SELECT
    ac.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
    ac.art_title AS artifact_title,
    ac."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
    (
        (
            r."HIST_sign"
            + CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.research_score') AS DOUBLE)
            + CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score') AS DOUBLE)
        )
        * (
            10 - (
                SELECT CASE ac2.conserve_status
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                END
                FROM main.ArtifactsCore ac2
                WHERE ac2.ARTregID = r."ART_link"
            )
        )
    ) / 30.0 AS priority_score,
    COALESCE(ab.specific_budget, 'Not assigned') AS specific_budget,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ab.maintenance_record_count, 0) = 0
          OR ab.non_adequate_allocations > 0
        THEN 'Insufficient'
        ELSE 'Sufficient'
    END AS funding_sufficiency
FROM main.ArtifactsCore ac
JOIN main.ArtifactRatings r
    ON r."ART_link" = ac.ARTregID
LEFT JOIN artifact_budgets ab
    ON ab.ARTregID = ac.ARTregID
ORDER BY ac."DYNASTY" NULLS LAST, ac.ARTregID;
```

answer:
I calculated each artifact’s environmental risk factor (ERF) as the average of its available environmental sensitivities, using Low = 1, Medium = 5, and High = 10. “Organic material vulnerable” follows the knowledge-base definition: Wood, Textile, or Paper with an overall sensitivity rating (`ENVsense`) of High. The counts include artifacts with sensitivity profiles, since those are needed to calculate ERF.

| Material | Vulnerability status | Average environmental risk | Artifact count |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Stone | Not organic-material vulnerable | 6.67 | 1 |
| Jade | Not organic-material vulnerable | 6.50 | 1 |
| Textile | Organic material vulnerable | 5.40 | 1 |

```sql
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT
    a.ARTregID,
    a.MatKind,
    CASE
      WHEN a.MatKind IN ('Wood', 'Textile', 'Paper')
           AND s.ENVsense = 'High'
        THEN 'Organic material vulnerable'
      ELSE 'Not organic-material vulnerable'
    END AS vulnerability_status,
    (
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'light'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'temperature'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'humidity'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'vibration'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'pollutants'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
    )::DOUBLE /
    NULLIF(
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'light'
        IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'temperature'
        IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'humidity'
        IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'vibration'
        IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity -> 'environment' ->> 'pollutants'
        IN ('Low', 'Medium', 'High') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      0
    ) AS environmental_risk
  FROM ArtifactsCore AS a
  JOIN SensitivityData AS s
    ON s.ART_link = a.ARTregID
)
SELECT
  MatKind AS material,
  vulnerability_status,
  AVG(environmental_risk) AS average_environmental_risk,
  COUNT(*) AS artifact_count
FROM scored
GROUP BY MatKind, vulnerability_status
ORDER BY average_environmental_risk DESC;
```

answer:
The query returns one row per resting usage-record/artifact pairing: 332 rows from 300 resting usage records. Rotation scores are `NULL` when required rating or sensitivity inputs are unavailable; those rows are labeled `Monitor`.

```sql
WITH resting AS (
    SELECT
        u.usage_id,
        ca.art_exam AS artifact_id,
        ac.art_title,
        ac.MatKind AS material,
        u.displayMonths AS months_on_display,
        ar.HIST_sign,
        json_extract_string(ar.rating_profile, '$.research_score')::DOUBLE
            AS research_score,
        json_extract_string(ar.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score')::DOUBLE
            AS cultural_score,
        CASE ac.conserve_status
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
        END AS status_value,
        CASE json_extract_string(
            sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light'
        )
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10
        END AS light_weight,
        CASE json_extract_string(
            sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature'
        )
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10
        END AS temp_weight,
        CASE json_extract_string(
            sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity'
        )
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5
            WHEN 'High' THEN 10
        END AS humidity_weight,
        lr.lux,
        lr.visLxh
    FROM UsageRecords AS u
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
        ON e.monitor_code = u.env_link
    JOIN ConditionAssessments AS ca
        ON ca.case_exam = e.case_link
    JOIN ArtifactsCore AS ac
        ON ac.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    LEFT JOIN ArtifactRatings AS ar
        ON ar.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN SensitivityData AS sd
        ON sd.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings AS lr
        ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
    WHERE u.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (36 * (10 - light_weight) * (10 - temp_weight)
            * (10 - humidity_weight)) / 1000.0
            AS max_safe_display_months,
        (HIST_sign + research_score + cultural_score)
            * (10 - status_value) / 30.0
            AS cpi,
        (lux * light_weight * visLxh) / 1000.0 AS ler
    FROM resting
)
SELECT
    usage_id,
    artifact_id,
    art_title,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    max_safe_display_months,
    (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
        * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0
        AS rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
            * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0 < 0
            THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_recommendation
FROM scored
ORDER BY artifact_id, usage_id;
```

        END AS humidity_weight,
        lr.lux,
        lr.visLxh
    FROM UsageRecords AS u
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
        ON e.monitor_code = u.env_link
    JOIN ConditionAssessments AS ca
        ON ca.case_exam = e.case_link
    JOIN ArtifactsCore AS ac
        ON ac.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    LEFT JOIN ArtifactRatings AS ar
        ON ar.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN SensitivityData AS sd
        ON sd.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings AS lr
        ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
    WHERE u.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (36 * (10 - light_weight) * (10 - temp_weight)
            * (10 - humidity_weight)) / 1000.0
            AS max_safe_display_months,
        (HIST_sign + research_score + cultural_score)
            * (10 - status_value) / 30.0
            AS cpi,
        (lux * light_weight * visLxh) / 1000.0 AS ler
    FROM resting
)
SELECT
    usage_id,
    artifact_id,
    art_title,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    max_safe_display_months,
    (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
        * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0
        AS rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (max_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
            * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0 < 0
            THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_recommendation
FROM scored
ORDER BY artifact_id, usage_id;

The governed **high-value artifact** definition cannot be computed exactly from this schema: insurance values aren’t linked to individual artifacts, and the historical-significance score it requires isn’t available as a score. As a transparent proxy, I treated artifacts in the **top decile of available exhibit-value scores** as “really valuable.” Cultural-score averages exclude NULL scores.

With that proxy, the result is **Ming — 1 artifact — average cultural score 35.0**.

```sql
WITH scored_artifacts AS (
    SELECT
        a."ARTregID",
        a."DYNASTY" AS historical_period,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.exhibit_value') AS DOUBLE) AS exhibit_value,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score') AS DOUBLE) AS cultural_score
    FROM main.ArtifactsCore AS a
    JOIN main.ArtifactRatings AS r
      ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
),
cutoff AS (
    SELECT quantile_cont(exhibit_value, 0.9) AS exhibit_value_cutoff
    FROM scored_artifacts
    WHERE exhibit_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    s.historical_period AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS valuable_artifact_count,
    AVG(s.cultural_score) AS average_cultural_score
FROM scored_artifacts AS s
CROSS JOIN cutoff AS c
WHERE s.exhibit_value IS NOT NULL
  AND s.exhibit_value >= c.exhibit_value_cutoff
GROUP BY s.historical_period
ORDER BY valuable_artifact_count DESC, period ASC;
```

The rotation calculation is not fully determinable from the schema: `UsageRecords` links to a monitor, not directly to an artifact, and the metric definition notes there is no unique rule for mapping display months to an artifact. The query below uses the available monitor → showcase → condition-assessment path; that can produce duplicate artifact rows when multiple records share a showcase. Missing sensitivity or assessment inputs also leave the calculated duration or score `NULL`.

```sql
WITH resting_rows AS (
    SELECT
        u.usage_id,
        u.env_link,
        u.displayMonths,
        e.case_link,
        ca.art_exam,
        ca.light_link
    FROM main.UsageRecords AS u
    JOIN main.EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
      ON e.monitor_code = u.env_link
    JOIN main.ConditionAssessments AS ca
      ON ca.case_exam = e.case_link
    WHERE u.rotate_sched = 'Resting'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        rr.usage_id,
        a.ARTregID AS artifact_id,
        a.art_title AS artifact_name,
        a.MatKind AS material,
        rr.displayMonths AS months_on_display,
        (
            36
            * (10 - CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            * (10 - CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
            * (10 - CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END)
        ) / 1000.0 AS maximum_safe_display_months,
        (
            (
                (
                    ar."HIST_sign"
                    + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::NUMERIC
                    + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::NUMERIC
                )
                * (
                    10 - CASE a.conserve_status
                        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                    END
                )
            ) / 30.0
        ) AS cpi,
        (
            lr.lux
            * CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10
              END
            * lr.visLxh
        ) / 1000.0 AS ler
    FROM resting_rows AS rr
    JOIN main.ArtifactsCore AS a
      ON a.ARTregID = rr.art_exam
    LEFT JOIN main.SensitivityData AS s
      ON s.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN main.ArtifactRatings AS ar
      ON ar.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    LEFT JOIN main.LightAndRadiationReadings AS lr
      ON lr.rad_id = rr.light_link
)
SELECT
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    material,
    months_on_display,
    maximum_safe_display_months,
    (
        (maximum_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
        * (ler + 1)
        * (cpi + 1)
    ) / 100.0 AS final_rotation_priority_score,
    CASE
        WHEN (
            (maximum_safe_display_months - months_on_display)
            * (ler + 1)
            * (cpi + 1)
        ) / 100.0 < 0
            THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS rotation_flag
FROM scored
ORDER BY artifact_id, usage_id;
```

Organic-material vulnerability is classified as `Vulnerable` when the material is Wood, Textile, or Paper and its overall environmental sensitivity is High. Non-organic materials are labeled `Not Organic`. The average risk is NULL where no environmental sensitivity factors were available; those groups are sorted last.

| Material | Vulnerability status | Average environmental risk | Artifact count |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Stone | Not Organic | 6.67 | 135 |
| Jade | Not Organic | 6.50 | 144 |
| Textile | Vulnerable | 5.40 | 1 |
| Bronze | Not Organic | NULL | 137 |
| Ceramic | Not Organic | NULL | 140 |
| Paper | Not Vulnerable | NULL | 152 |
| Wood | Not Vulnerable | NULL | 150 |
| Textile | Not Vulnerable | NULL | 136 |

```sql
WITH artifact_erf AS (
  SELECT
    a.ARTregID,
    a.MatKind,
    CASE
      WHEN a.MatKind NOT IN ('Wood', 'Textile', 'Paper') THEN 'Not Organic'
      WHEN s.ENVsense = 'High' THEN 'Vulnerable'
      ELSE 'Not Vulnerable'
    END AS vulnerability_status,
    (
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
      COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants'
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
    )::DOUBLE / NULLIF(
      (CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      0
    ) AS environmental_risk
  FROM ArtifactsCore a
  LEFT JOIN SensitivityData s ON s.ART_link = a.ARTregID
)
SELECT
  MatKind AS material,
  vulnerability_status,
  AVG(environmental_risk) AS average_environmental_risk,
  COUNT(*) AS artifact_count
FROM artifact_erf
GROUP BY MatKind, vulnerability_status
ORDER BY average_environmental_risk DESC NULLS LAST;
```

The schema doesn’t define a combined risk-score formula, so I used the **conservation score plus an ordinal sensitivity bonus** (High = 3, Medium = 2, Low = 1). By that calculation, the highest score is **86** for **ART54317 (Culture Painting)**: conservation score 85 and environmental sensitivity Low.

```sql
WITH scored AS (
```

answer:
The second-highest official risk level is **Medium**. Of those artifacts, only one has complete inputs for the total environmental threat calculation:

| Registration ID | Total environmental threat score |
|---|---:|
| ART54254 | 9655.619616 |

The other Medium-risk artifact with a sensitivity profile lacks a lux reading, so its score cannot be calculated. The query uses the latest condition assessment per artifact and averages the available environmental sensitivity weights when some are missing.

```sql
WITH env_scores AS (
    SELECT
        s.ART_link,
        AVG(CASE json_extract_string(s.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light')
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END) AS light_w,
        AVG(CASE json_extract_string(s.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature')
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END) AS temp_w,
        AVG(CASE json_extract_string(s.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity')
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END) AS humidity_w,
        AVG(CASE json_extract_string(s.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration')
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END) AS vibration_w,
        AVG(CASE json_extract_string(s.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants')
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END) AS pollutants_w
    FROM SensitivityData AS s
    GROUP BY s.ART_link
),
artifact_erf AS (
    SELECT
        ART_link,
        (
            COALESCE(light_w, 0) +
            COALESCE(temp_w, 0) +
            COALESCE(humidity_w, 0) +
            COALESCE(vibration_w, 0) +
            COALESCE(pollutants_w, 0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            (light_w IS NOT NULL)::INT +
            (temp_w IS NOT NULL)::INT +
            (humidity_w IS NOT NULL)::INT +
            (vibration_w IS NOT NULL)::INT +
            (pollutants_w IS NOT NULL)::INT,
            0
        ) AS erf
    FROM env_scores
),
ranked_readings AS (
    SELECT
        c.art_exam,
        l.lux,
        l.visLxh,
        e.TEMPc,
        e.RH,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.art_exam
            ORDER BY c.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, c.cond_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM ConditionAssessments AS c
    JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings AS l
        ON l.rad_id = c.light_link
    JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore AS e
        ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        a.ARTregID,
        er.erf
        + (rr.lux * es.light_w * rr.visLxh / 1000.0)
        + 2.0 * (
            a.ageYears * er.erf * POWER(rr.RH - 50, 2) * rr.TEMPc / 100000.0
        ) AS total_environmental_threat
    FROM RiskAssessments AS r
    JOIN ArtifactsCore AS a
        ON a.ARTregID = r.art_concern
    JOIN artifact_erf AS er
        ON er.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    JOIN env_scores AS es
        ON es.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    JOIN ranked_readings AS rr
        ON rr.art_exam = a.ARTregID
       AND rr.rn = 1
    WHERE r.risk_level = 'Medium'
)
SELECT
    ARTregID,
    total_environmental_threat
FROM scores
WHERE total_environmental_threat IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total_environmental_threat DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Using sensor variation of **≥1.5°C** or **≥4 RH points**, or a **Poor** seal, as “very unstable”; and counting the specified overdue, replacement, seal, and safety/power states as major maintenance problems, **692 display cases** meet at least one criterion.

```sql
WITH case_risk AS (
  SELECT
    s.caseID,
    (
      json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.physical_state.seal_state') = 'Poor'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM EnvironmentalReadingsCore e
        WHERE e.case_link = s.caseID
          AND (e."tempVar24" >= 1.5 OR e."RHvar" >= 4)
      )
    ) AS very_unstable,
    (
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.maint_status') = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.filter_status') = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.maintenance.silica_status') = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.physical_state.seal_state') = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.inert_gas_state') = 'Maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.fire_system_state') = 'Maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.backup_power_state') = 'Maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
      (CASE WHEN json_extract_string(s.case_environment_profile, '$.safety_and_power.primary_power_state') = 'Testing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
```

The highest Artifact Vulnerability Score (AVS)—Conservation Priority Index multiplied by Environmental Risk Factor—is **149.8**, for artifact **ART48028**.

```sql
WITH components AS (
    SELECT
        a.ARTregID,
        r.HIST_sign,
        CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.research_score') AS DOUBLE) AS research_score,
        CAST(json_extract_string(r.rating_profile, '$.cultural_score') AS DOUBLE) AS cultural_score,
        CASE a.conserve_status
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
        END AS status_value,
        s.env_handling_sensitivity
    FROM ArtifactsCore a
    JOIN ArtifactRatings r ON r.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    JOIN SensitivityData s ON s.ART_link = a.ARTregID
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        ARTregID,
        ((HIST_sign + research_score + cultural_score) * (10 - status_value) / 30.0) AS cpi,
        (
            COALESCE(CASE json_extract_string(env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light')
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
```

The average compatibility is **7.29 out of 10**. Only one Ming-dynasty artifact–showcase pairing had the sensitivity and environmental readings needed to calculate the score, so the average is based on that single pairing.

```sql
WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    a."ARTregID",
    ca.case_exam,
    s.case_environment_profile,
    e."tempVar24",
    e."RHvar",
    json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.light') AS light_sens,
    json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.temperature') AS temp_sens,
    json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.humidity') AS humidity_sens,
    json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.vibration') AS vibration_sens,
    json_extract_string(sd.env_handling_sensitivity, '$.environment.pollutants') AS pollutants_sens
  FROM ConditionAssessments ca
  JOIN ArtifactsCore a
    ON a."ARTregID" = ca.art_exam
  JOIN SensitivityData sd
    ON sd.ART_link = a."ARTregID"
  JOIN Showcases s
    ON s.caseID = ca.case_exam
  LEFT JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings l
    ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
  LEFT JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore e
    ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" = 'Ming'
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (
      SELECT AVG(v)
      FROM (VALUES
        (CASE light_sens      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END),
        (CASE temp_sens       WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END),
        (CASE humidity_sens   WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END),
        (CASE vibration_sens  WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END),
        (CASE pollutants_sens WHEN 'Low' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'High' THEN 10.0 END)
      ) AS sensitivity_values(v)
    ) AS erf,
    10.0 - (
      (
        "tempVar24"
        + ("RHvar" / 5.0)
        + TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(
              case_environment_profile,
              '$.physical_state.leak_rate_per_day'
            ) AS DOUBLE
          )
      ) / 3.0
    ) AS sesr
  FROM paired
)
SELECT AVG(10.0 - ABS(erf - sesr)) AS avg_compatibility
FROM scored
WHERE erf IS NOT NULL
  AND sesr IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
```

There are 198 patients with positive crossmatch results. Their latest match-attempt date is 2025-02-19 when a recorded attempt exists; 9 have no match attempt in `transplant_matching`.

The schema does not contain the official AMR risk-stratification rules or a PRA threshold, so I can’t verify an official “High Risk” classification from this database alone. In the query below, **High Risk** is an explicit proxy: **PRA ≥ 80 or DSA positive**. Under that proxy, 130 are High Risk and 68 are Not High Risk. The query uses the latest `created_ts` as the last match-attempt date.

```sql
WITH latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        recip_ref_reg,
        CAST(MAX(CAST(created_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS last_match_date
    FROM transplant_matching
    GROUP BY recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT
    i.immu_recip_registry AS patient_id,
    i.pra_score,
    i.dsa_state,
    CASE
        WHEN i.pra_score >= 80
          OR lower(trim(i.dsa_state)) = 'positive'
        THEN 'High Risk'
        ELSE 'Not High Risk'
    END AS amr_risk,
    lm.last_match_date
FROM recipients_immunology AS i
LEFT JOIN latest_match AS lm
    ON lm.recip_ref_reg = i.immu_recip_registry
WHERE lower(trim(i.cross_result)) = 'positive'
ORDER BY i.pra_score DESC NULLS LAST, i.immu_recip_registry;
```

I treated “finished” as matches with `match_status = 'Completed'` and calculated the ratio as **estimated cost ÷ (recipient quality-of-life score × 5 years)**. Of the 26 completed lung matches, 22 have a usable quality-of-life score; the other 4 can’t be ranked on this measure.

Using 20 groups ordered from lowest ratio (best) to highest (worst):

| Group | Match ID | Donor ID | Recipient ID | Cost-effectiveness ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Best | TM831296 | D494745 | R767148 | 672.05 |
| Best | TM491235 | D340458 | R300062 | 878.17 |
| Worst | TM923489 | D530861 | R836178 | 52,355.43 |

```sql
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_id,
        try_cast(
            regexp_replace(cm.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS DOUBLE
        ) / (r.qol_val * 5.0) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
        ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN risk_evaluation AS r
        ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.org_spec)) = 'lung'
      AND lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
      AND r.qol_val IS NOT NULL
      AND r.qol_val > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(20) OVER (
            ORDER BY cost_effectiveness_ratio ASC, match_id
        ) AS group_num
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    group_num,
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    recipient_id,
    ROUND(cost_effectiveness_ratio, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE group_num IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY group_num, cost_effectiveness_ratio;
```

Only one artifact in the second-highest risk group (Medium) has a non-NULL total environmental threat score from the available linked data. Its score is **9,655.619616**.

```sql
WITH medium_risk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT art_concern AS art_id
  FROM RiskAssessments
  WHERE risk_level = 'Medium'
),
sensitivity AS (
  SELECT ART_link AS art_id,
         env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' AS light,
         env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' AS temperature,
         env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity,
         env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration' AS vibration,
         env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants' AS pollutants
  FROM SensitivityData
),
environmental_risk AS (
  SELECT art_id,
         (
           COALESCE(CASE light WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
           COALESCE(CASE temperature WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
           COALESCE(CASE humidity WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
           COALESCE(CASE vibration WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
           COALESCE(CASE pollutants WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
         )::DOUBLE /
         NULLIF(
           (light IS NOT NULL)::INT +
           (temperature IS NOT NULL)::INT +
           (humidity IS NOT NULL)::INT +
           (vibration IS NOT NULL)::INT +
           (pollutants IS NOT NULL)::INT,
           0
         ) AS erf,
         CASE light
           WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
           WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5
           WHEN 'High' THEN 10
         END AS light_weight
  FROM sensitivity
),
threat_scores AS (
  SELECT r.art_id,
         er.erf
           + (lr.lux * er.light_weight * lr."visLxh") / 1000.0
           + 2 * (
               (ac.ageYears * er.erf * POWER(erc."RH" - 50, 2) * erc."TEMPc")
               / 100000.0
             ) AS total_environmental_threat
  FROM medium_risk r
  JOIN environmental_risk er ON er.art_id = r.art_id
  JOIN ArtifactsCore ac ON ac.ARTregID = r.art_id
  JOIN ConditionAssessments ca ON ca.art_exam = r.art_id
  JOIN LightAndRadiationReadings lr ON lr.rad_id = ca.light_link
  JOIN EnvironmentalReadingsCore erc ON erc.monitor_code = lr.env_link
)
SELECT art_id AS registration_id,
       total_environmental_threat AS threat_score
FROM threat_scores
WHERE total_environmental_threat IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY threat_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

I treated **Completed** lung matches with both a usable cost estimate and a quality-of-life score as rankable. Of 35 completed lung matches, 22 had both values. For each, I used `QALY = quality-of-life score × 5` and `CER = cost ÷ QALY`; lower CER is better. The 20 groups are ranked from best (group 1) to worst (group 20).

| Group | Match ID | Donor ID | Recipient ID | CER |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Best (1) | TM491235 | D340458 | R300062 | 878.17 |
| Best (1) | TM831296 | D494745 | R767148 | 672.05 |
| Worst (20) | TM923489 | D530861 | R836178 | 52,355.43 |

```sql
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_id,
        try_cast(
            nullif(regexp_replace(cm.cost_est, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS cost,
        r.qol_val AS qol
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
        ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN risk_evaluation AS r
        ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.org_spec)) = 'lung'
      AND lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        cost / (qol * 5.0) AS cer,
        ntile(20) OVER (
            ORDER BY cost / (qol * 5.0), match_id
        ) AS cer_group
    FROM eligible
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
      AND qol IS NOT NULL
      AND qol > 0
)
SELECT
    cer_group,
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    recipient_id,
    round(cer, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE cer_group IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY cer_group, cer DESC, match_id;
```

answer:
I treated **Medium** as the second-highest official risk level. I calculated threat at the condition-assessment level using that assessment’s linked light and environmental readings, then retained the highest score per artifact. Only one Medium-risk artifact had a non-NULL computable score from those linked readings, so fewer than 10 results are available.

| Registration ID | Threat score |
|---|---:|
| ART54254 | 9650.1992 |

```sql
WITH sensitivity_scores AS (
    SELECT
        s.ART_link,
        (
            COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants' WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END, 0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
            0
        ) AS erf,
        CASE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10
        END AS light_weight
    FROM main.SensitivityData s
),
per_assessment AS (
    SELECT
        a.ARTregID,
        ss.erf
        + (l.lux * ss.light_weight * l.visLxh) / 1000.0
        + 2 * ((a.ageYears * ss.erf * POWER(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc") / 100000) AS threat_score
    FROM main.ConditionAssessments ca
    JOIN main.ArtifactsCore a
        ON a.ARTregID = ca.art_exam
    JOIN sensitivity_scores ss
        ON ss.ART_link = a.ARTregID
    JOIN main.LightAndRadiationReadings l
        ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
    JOIN main.EnvironmentalReadingsCore e
        ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM main.RiskAssessments ra
        WHERE ra.art_concern = a.ARTregID
          AND ra.risk_level = 'Medium'
    )
),
per_artifact AS (
    SELECT
        ARTregID,
        MAX(threat_score) AS threat_score
    FROM per_assessment
    GROUP BY ARTregID
)
SELECT ARTregID, threat_score
FROM per_artifact
WHERE threat_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY threat_score DESC, ARTregID
LIMIT 10;
```

There are **198 patients** with positive crossmatch results; **22** meet the official AMR **High Risk** criteria. Nine have no recorded match attempt, so their last-match date is `NULL`. The query returns each patient’s DSA status and sorts by PRA score, highest first.

```sql
  ON lm.recip_ref_reg = ri.immu_recip_registry
WHERE ri.cross_result = 'Positive'
```

I used `risk_evaluation.alloc_prio_val` as the Patient Urgency Score. Where a patient has multiple matching records for the same organ, the query averages those scores first, so each patient contributes once to the comparison average. “More stable” means not on ECMO or a VAD; this includes patients on mechanical ventilation and those with no recorded life support.

The output contains **382 ECMO/VAD patient-organ entries**. The score gap is the patient’s score minus the stable-patient average for that organ; a negative gap means their score is below that average. Some patient scores are unavailable because no allocation-priority score is recorded for their matches.

| Organ | ECMO/VAD average score | Stable-patient average | Average gap |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Heart | 0.4227 | 0.4728 | -0.0501 |
| Kidney | 0.4719 | 0.4899 | -0.0180 |
| Liver | 0.5388 | 0.4842 | +0.0546 |
| Lung | 0.4656 | 0.5611 | -0.0954 |
| Pancreas | 0.5244 | 0.4931 | +0.0313 |

```sql
WITH patient_organ_scores AS (
    SELECT
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
        tm.org_spec AS organ,
        ri.life_support,
        AVG(re.alloc_prio_val) AS patient_urgency_score
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN recipients_immunology AS ri
        ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
        ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    GROUP BY
        tm.recip_ref_reg,
        tm.org_spec,
        ri.life_support
),
stable_organ_averages AS (
    SELECT
        organ,
        AVG(patient_urgency_score) AS stable_avg_score
    FROM patient_organ_scores
    WHERE life_support IS NULL
       OR life_support NOT IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
    GROUP BY organ
)
SELECT
    p.organ,
    p.patient_id,
    p.life_support,
    ROUND(p.patient_urgency_score, 4) AS patient_urgency_score,
    ROUND(s.stable_avg_score, 4) AS stable_patients_avg_score,
    ROUND(p.patient_urgency_score - s.stable_avg_score, 4) AS gap_vs_stable_avg
FROM patient_organ_scores AS p
JOIN stable_organ_averages AS s
    ON s.organ = p.organ
WHERE p.life_support IN ('ECMO', 'VAD')
ORDER BY
    p.organ,
    CASE p.life_support WHEN 'ECMO' THEN 1 WHEN 'VAD' THEN 2 END,
    p.patient_urgency_score DESC NULLS LAST,
    p.patient_id;
```

I calculated CER as **estimated cost ÷ (recipient quality-of-life score × 5 years)**. Among 35 completed lung matches, 22 had the data needed to calculate it; 13 were missing a required cost or quality-of-life value (or its associated record).

Groups are ordered from lowest CER to highest: **group 1 is the best bargain**, and **group 20 is the most expensive relative to benefit**.

| Group | Match ID | Donor ID | Recipient ID | CER |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 (best) | TM831296 | D494745 | R767148 | 672.05 |
| 1 (best) | TM491235 | D340458 | R300062 | 878.17 |
| 20 (worst) | TM923489 | D530861 | R836178 | 52,355.43 |

```sql
WITH calculable AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_id,
        CAST(regexp_extract(cm.cost_est, '[0-9.]+') AS DOUBLE) AS estimated_cost,
        re.qol_val
    FROM transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN compatibility_metrics AS cm
      ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN risk_evaluation AS re
      ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE tm.org_spec = 'Lung'
      AND tm.match_status = 'Completed'
      AND cm.cost_est IS NOT NULL
      AND regexp_extract(coalesce(cm.cost_est, ''), '[0-9.]+') <> ''
      AND re.qol_val IS NOT NULL
      AND re.qol_val > 0
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        estimated_cost / (qol_val * 5.0) AS cer
    FROM calculable
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(20) OVER (ORDER BY cer ASC, match_id ASC) AS ratio_group
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    recipient_id,
    ratio_group,
    ROUND(cer, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
FROM bucketed
WHERE ratio_group IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY ratio_group, cer, match_id;
```

The official AMR rule classifies a positive-crossmatch patient as **High Risk** only when PRA is at least 80 and DSA status is Positive; otherwise they are **Standard Risk**. The executed result preview was truncated after 50 rows, but the query below returns the complete list. It uses the latest algorithm execution timestamp (`match_ts`); a NULL date means no matching attempt was recorded.

```sql
WITH last_match_attempt AS (
    SELECT
        recip_ref_reg,
        CAST(MAX(TRY_STRPTIME(match_ts, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%M:%S')) AS DATE)
            AS last_match_attempt_date
    FROM main.transplant_matching
    GROUP BY recip_ref_reg
)
SELECT
    i.immu_recip_registry AS patient_id,
    i.pra_score,
    i.dsa_state AS dsa_status,
    CASE
        WHEN i.cross_result = 'Positive'
             AND i.pra_score >= 80
             AND i.dsa_state = 'Positive'
            THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN i.cross_result = 'Positive'
            THEN 'Standard Risk'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS amr_risk,
    l.last_match_attempt_date
FROM main.recipients_immunology AS i
```

I treated urgency status as the primary sort key and the A/B/DR HLA mismatch count (ascending) as the tie-breaker. Equal-priority matches with the same mismatch count share a rank. The query includes all 34 pending pancreas matches; `local_rank` is `NULL` where the region, urgency, or HLA data needed to rank the match is missing.

```sql
WITH pending_pancreas AS (
  SELECT
    tm.match_rec_registry,
    tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(ad.allc_region), '') AS region,
    cl.med_urgency AS urgency_status,
    CASE
      WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
      WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
      WHEN cl.med_urgency IN ('Status 2', '2') THEN 3
      WHEN cl.med_urgency IN ('Status 3', '3') THEN 2
      WHEN cl.med_urgency IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      ELSE NULL
    END AS urgency_priority,
    CASE
      WHEN h.hla_a_val IS NULL OR h.hla_b_val IS NULL OR h.hla_dr_val IS NULL
        OR (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val') IS NULL
        OR (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val') IS NULL
        OR (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val') IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE
        CASE WHEN h.hla_a_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_A_Val')::REAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN h.hla_b_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_B_Val')::REAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN h.hla_dr_val <> (ri.hlaprofile->>'Hla_Dr_Val')::REAL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    END AS hla_mismatch
  FROM transplant_matching tm
  LEFT JOIN allocation_details ad
    ON ad.allc_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
  LEFT JOIN clinical cl
    ON cl.clin_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN hla_info h
    ON h.immu_don_registry = tm.donor_ref_reg
  LEFT JOIN recipients_immunology ri
    ON ri.immu_recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
  WHERE tm.org_spec = 'Pancreas'
    AND tm.match_status = 'Pending'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    match_rec_registry,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY region
      ORDER BY urgency_priority DESC, hla_mismatch ASC
    ) AS local_rank
  FROM pending_pancreas
  WHERE region IS NOT NULL
    AND urgency_priority IS NOT NULL
    AND hla_mismatch IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.patient_id,
  p.region,
  p.urgency_status,
  p.hla_mismatch,
  r.local_rank
FROM pending_pancreas p
LEFT JOIN ranked r
  ON r.match_rec_registry = p.match_rec_registry
ORDER BY p.region NULLS LAST, r.local_rank NULLS LAST, p.patient_id;
```

```sql
WITH ethnicities(ethnicity) AS (
    VALUES ('African'), ('Asian'), ('Caucasian'), ('Hispanic'), ('Other')
),
perfect_matches AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(d.physicalstats, '$.Ethnicity') AS donor_ethnicity,
        r.ethn_grp AS recipient_ethnicity
    FROM compatibility_metrics cm
    JOIN demographics d
      ON d.contrib_registry = cm.donor_ref_reg
    JOIN recipients_demographics r
      ON r.recip_registry = cm.recip_ref_reg
    WHERE cm.hla_mis_count = 0
      AND (
          LEFT(d.blood_class, 1) = 'O'
          OR LEFT(r.blood_class, 2) = 'AB'
          OR LEFT(d.blood_class, 1) = LEFT(r.blood_class, 1)
      )
      AND 1 - ABS(
          CAST(json_extract_string(d.physicalstats, '$.Bmi_Value') AS REAL)
          / r.bmi_val - 1
      ) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 1.1
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        donor_ethnicity,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'African') AS African,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Asian') AS Asian,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Caucasian') AS Caucasian,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Hispanic') AS Hispanic,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE recipient_ethnicity = 'Other') AS Other,
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM perfect_matches
    GROUP BY donor_ethnicity
)
SELECT
    e.ethnicity AS donor_ethnicity,
    COALESCE(p.African, 0) AS African,
    COALESCE(p.Asian, 0) AS Asian,
    COALESCE(p.Caucasian, 0) AS Caucasian,
    COALESCE(p.Hispanic, 0) AS Hispanic,
    COALESCE(p.Other, 0) AS Other,
    COALESCE(p.total, 0) AS total
FROM ethnicities e
LEFT JOIN pivoted p
  ON p.donor_ethnicity = e.ethnicity
ORDER BY e.ethnicity;
```

Among completed transplants with a recorded transport method, Ground had the highest average Expected Graft Survival Score. The averages are sorted by that score, highest first. Total ischemia time is calculated as expected ischemia time plus expected transport time. Completed records without a recorded transport method are excluded.

| Transport method | Avg. total ischemia time (min) | Avg. expected graft survival score |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ground | 572.27 | 0.5384 |
| Commercial Air | 596.37 | 0.5066 |
| Helicopter | 553.84 | 0.4871 |
| Charter Air | 538.90 | 0.4631 |

```sql
WITH completed AS (
    SELECT
        l.trans_method,
        regexp_extract(c.exp_isch_time, '[0-9]+', 0)::DOUBLE
          + regexp_extract(c.exp_time, '[0-9]+', 0)::DOUBLE AS total_ischemia_time,
        r.egs_val
    FROM transplant_matching tm
    JOIN logistics l
      ON l.log_match_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN compatibility_metrics c
      ON c.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation r
      ON r.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(trim(tm.match_status)) = 'completed'
      AND l.trans_method IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    trans_method,
    ROUND(AVG(total_ischemia_time), 2) AS avg_total_ischemia_time,
    ROUND(AVG(egs_val), 4) AS avg_expected_graft_survival_score
FROM completed
GROUP BY trans_method
ORDER BY avg_expected_graft_survival_score DESC,
         avg_total_ischemia_time ASC;
```

I calculated CER as **estimated transplant cost ÷ (recipient quality-of-life score × 5 years)**, using the cost in `compatibility_metrics.cost_est`. Of 22 completed lung transplants with a parseable cost and a positive, non-NULL quality-of-life score, `NTILE(20)` places the lowest CERs in group 1 (best bargains) and the highest in group 20 (worst value).

| Group | Match ID | Donor ID | Recipient ID | CER |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Best | TM831296 | D494745 | R767148 | 672.05 |
| Best | TM491235 | D340458 | R300062 | 878.13 |
| Worst | TM923489 | D530861 | R836178 | 52,354.55 |

```sql
WITH lung_completed AS (
    SELECT
        tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
        tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
        tm.recip_ref_reg AS recipient_id,
        TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(cm.cost_est, '[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?') AS DOUBLE) AS cost,
        re.qol_val AS quality_score
    FROM main.transplant_matching AS tm
    JOIN main.compatibility_metrics AS cm
      ON cm.match_comp_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    JOIN main.risk_evaluation AS re
      ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
    WHERE lower(tm.org_spec) = 'lung'
      AND lower(tm.match_status) = 'completed'
),
cer_values AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        cost / NULLIF(quality_score * 5.0, 0.0) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio
    FROM lung_completed
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
      AND quality_score IS NOT NULL
      AND quality_score > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        donor_id,
        recipient_id,
        cost_effectiveness_ratio,
        NTILE(20) OVER (
            ORDER BY cost_effectiveness_ratio ASC, match_id ASC
        ) AS ratio_group
    FROM cer_values
)
SELECT
    match_id,
    donor_id,
    recipient_id,
    ROUND(cost_effectiveness_ratio, 2) AS cost_effectiveness_ratio,
    CASE WHEN ratio_group = 1 THEN 'best' ELSE 'worst' END AS extreme_group
FROM ranked
WHERE ratio_group IN (1, 20)
ORDER BY ratio_group ASC, cost_effectiveness_ratio ASC, match_id ASC
```
